ns2:course.label: Science and Pseudoscience
ns2:course.description: Extra-sensory perception, alien abduction, and psychic crime-solving from the standpoint of scientific inquiry and exploration; the scientific method, how science progresses, and the types of argumentative fallacies that pervade the pseudoscientific community; examples of good science and how the scientific method is self-correcting.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
